inputs.code:
# PRESET TABLE – edit the theme values here.
# w, h = image size when ASPECT RATIO is "Theme default"  |  shift = sampling shift
# lora = base (theme) LoRA strength, 0 = not used (the Control panel switches can override it)
# refine = refine denoise  |  upscale = final upscale denoise
# groups = recommended steps (shown only)  |  pre = added before the prompt  |  post = added after the prompt
presets = {
  "None (own prompt only)": {"w": 832, "h": 1216, "shift": 3.0, "lora": 0.0, "refine": 0.25, "upscale": 0.2, "groups": "",
    "pre": "",
    "post": ""},
  "Portrait": {"people": 1, "w": 832, "h": 1216, "shift": 3.0, "lora": 0.9, "refine": 0.25, "upscale": 0.15, "groups": "2, 3",
    "pre": "detailed photorealistic cinematic style, incredibly lifelike portrait photograph. ",
    "post": " Shot on an 85mm lens with shallow depth of field, soft natural light, detailed skin pore, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the eyes. No text, no watermark."},
  "People – full body": {"people": 1, "w": 832, "h": 1216, "shift": 3.25, "lora": 1.0, "refine": 0.3, "upscale": 0.2, "groups": "2, 3, 3b",
    "pre": "detailed photorealistic cinematic style, realism style, candid photograph. ",
    "post": " Natural pose, natural skin texture, unstaged documentary realism, 35mm lens. Correct human anatomy, no text, no watermark."},
  "Landscape – nature": {"w": 1216, "h": 832, "shift": 3.5, "lora": 0.3, "refine": 0.35, "upscale": 0.22, "groups": "2, 4",
    "pre": "ultra detailed, sharp, realistic landscape photography. ",
    "post": " Wide-angle lens, deep depth of field, sharp foreground detail, atmospheric haze in the distance, natural colors. No text, no watermark."},
  "Architecture – cityscape": {"w": 1216, "h": 832, "shift": 3.75, "lora": 0.4, "refine": 0.25, "upscale": 0.15, "groups": "2, 4",
    "pre": "ultra detailed, sharp, architectural photography. ",
    "post": " Tilt-shift lens with straight vertical lines, deep depth of field, clean geometric lines, realistic materials. No text, no signage, no watermark."},
  "Interior": {"w": 1216, "h": 832, "shift": 3.25, "lora": 0.4, "refine": 0.28, "upscale": 0.18, "groups": "2, 4",
    "pre": "ultra detailed, sharp, interior design photography. ",
    "post": " Wide-angle lens with straight vertical lines, natural window light, realistic material textures, tidy uncluttered room. No text, no watermark."},
  "Product – object – food": {"w": 1024, "h": 1024, "shift": 2.75, "lora": 0.45, "refine": 0.25, "upscale": 0.15, "groups": "2, 4",
    "pre": "Sharp detailed high quality image, professional product photography. ",
    "post": " Soft diffused studio lighting, soft shadow on the surface, macro lens, centered composition, clean plain backdrop. No logos, no text, no watermark."},
  "Animal – macro": {"w": 1216, "h": 832, "shift": 2.75, "lora": 0.55, "refine": 0.32, "upscale": 0.2, "groups": "2, 4",
    "pre": "ultra detailed, sharp, wildlife and macro photography. ",
    "post": " Telephoto lens with softly blurred background, individual hairs and fine texture visible, catchlight in the eye, natural light. Correct animal anatomy, no text, no watermark."},
}
sizes = {"Portrait 832×1216": [832, 1216], "Landscape 1216×832": [1216, 832], "Square 1024×1024": [1024, 1024], "Wide 1280×768": [1280, 768], "Tall 768×1280": [768, 1280]}

# DEFAULT LOOK – for themes with "people": 1 (Portrait, People), and for "None" when the prompt describes a person;
# only while the DEFAULT LOOK switch is ON (input i).
# Z-Image Turbo tends to draw East Asian faces by default; these two sentences change that default.
# If your own prompt names another origin (any of the skip_words, e.g. asian, japanese, african), the two sentences are left out.
look_pre = "The subject is a white European person. "
look_post = " The person is a white European with European facial features."
skip_words = r"\b(asian|chinese|japanese|korean|thai|vietnamese|filipino|filipina|indonesian|malaysian|mongolian|tibetan|indian|pakistani|bangladeshi|nepali|african|nigerian|ethiopian|kenyan|black (woman|man|girl|boy|person|people|lady|guy)|dark[- ]skinned|brown[- ]skinned|latina|latino|hispanic|mexican|brazilian|arab|arabic|middle[- ]eastern|persian|iranian|turkish|egyptian|moroccan|native american|indigenous|aboriginal|polynesian|maori|pacific islander|inuit|mixed[- ]race|biracial)\b"

# With the theme "None (own prompt only)" the default look is used too, but only when your prompt describes a person:
person_words = r"\b(1girl|1boy|woman|women|man|men|girl|girls|boy|boys|person|people|lady|ladies|guy|guys|female|male|portrait|face|selfie|model|couple|family|bride|groom|mother|father|grandmother|grandfather|he|she|her|his)\b"

# --- Do not edit below this line ---
preset = presets[a]
if not preset:
  preset = presets["None (own prompt only)"]
size = sizes[b]
if not size:
  size = [preset["w"], preset["h"]]
wid = size[0]
hei = size[1]
text = ""
if c:
  text = str(c).strip()
  # a negation like "not asian" backfires (the word "asian" still acts), so it is removed from the text
  text = re(r"(?i),?\s*\b(not|non|no)[- ]asian\b").sub("", text)
  text = text.strip().rstrip(" ,;")
pre = preset["pre"]
post = preset["post"]
if text and post:
  if not (text[-1] in ".!?"):
    text = text + "."
own = ""
if d:
  own = str(d).strip()
src_txt = "YOUR PROMPT box"
src_code = "own"
if str(c).strip() != own:
  src_txt = "NOT your own prompt! The 1a image description or the 1d embedded prompt is used instead - switch them off to use your own prompt."
  src_code = "image"
look_on = 0
look_txt = "–"
look_code = "na"
people = preset["people"]
if a == "None (own prompt only)" and text and re(person_words).search(text.lower()):
  people = 1
if people and not i:
  look_txt = "off (DEFAULT LOOK switch)"
  look_code = "off"
if i and people and text and (look_pre or look_post):
  if re(skip_words).search(text.lower()):
    look_txt = "skipped (the prompt names another origin)"
    look_code = "skipped"
  else:
    look_on = 1
    look_txt = "European (default look)"
    look_code = "on"
if look_on and not post and not (text[-1] in ".!?"):
  text = text + "."
if look_on:
  final = pre + look_pre + text + look_post + post
else:
  final = pre + text + post
shift = preset["shift"]
lora = preset["lora"]
lora_src = "by THEME"
lora_code = "theme"
if lora == 0:
  lora_src = "this theme uses no base LoRA"
  lora_code = "none"
# BASE (THEME) LoRA switches on the Control panel: g = ON/OFF, e = manual strength ON/OFF, f = manual strength value.
if e:
  lora = round(f, 2)
  if lora < 0.005:
    lora = 0.0
  lora_src = "MANUAL"
  lora_code = "manual"
if not g:
  lora = 0.0
  lora_src = "OFF"
  lora_code = "off"
# START IMAGE (group 1e): h = rewrite amount (denoise). When 1e is off, h is empty: empty canvas, denoise 1.0.
denoise = 1.0
i2i = 0
size_txt = f"{wid}×{hei}"
start_txt = "none (starts from an empty canvas)"
if h:
  denoise = round(h, 2)
  if denoise > 1:
    denoise = 1.0
  if denoise < 0.05:
    denoise = 0.05
  i2i = 1
  size_txt = "taken from the start image (about 1 megapixel)"
  start_txt = f"1e ON – rewrite amount (denoise): {denoise}"
refine = preset["refine"]
upscale = preset["upscale"]
groups = preset["groups"]
summary = f"Prompt source: {src_txt}\nTheme: {a}\nImage size: {size_txt}  |  Shift: {shift}  |  LoRA: {lora} ({lora_src})\nStart image: {start_txt}\nRefine denoise: {refine}  |  Upscale denoise: {upscale}\nDefault look: {look_txt}\nRecommended steps: {groups}"
info = f"src={src_code}|theme={a}|w={wid}|h={hei}|i2i={i2i}|denoise={denoise}|shift={shift}|lora={lora}|lora_src={lora_code}|refine={refine}|upscale={upscale}|look={look_code}|steps={groups}"
return (final, wid, hei, shift, lora, refine, upscale, summary, denoise, info)
